messages.author: Kristoffer Lundgren
messages.body:
Hello all,
I am wondering if it is possible to invoke external QM programs through the use of pysander when doing QM/MM? There seems to be an option in pysander to set qm_theory to ‘EXTERN’, but how do I through pysander then supply the rest of the settings needed for the QM program (i.e. Hamiltonian and basis set)?
Best regards
Kristoffer
